seoTitle: Email Header Analyzer: Received Path, SPF, DKIM, DMARC
metaDescription: Paste full email headers to trace each Received hop with delays, read SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, check alignment and spot spoofing signs.
intro: Find out where a message came from, how long each hop took and whether it passed authentication.
why:
The analyzer lists the Received chain oldest first with from/by hosts, protocols and timestamps, computes the delay between hops (flagging slow hops and clock skew), reads the Authentication-Results header for SPF, DKIM and DMARC, shows DKIM signature domains and selectors, compares the From and Return-Path domains and the DKIM domain for alignment, and notes a different Reply-To.

Headers added below your own server's lines can be forged, so trust only the Received and Authentication-Results lines added by servers you control. It does not query DNS to verify records.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: In your mail client open "Show original" or "View headers".
Copy all header lines and paste them.
Check SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS records if something fails.

faq.a: The domain in From must match the domain authenticated by SPF or DKIM.
Greylisting, queueing or scanning. Over five minutes is flagged.

faq.q: Can I trust the first Received line?
faq.a: The topmost line is added by your own server; lines further down can be forged.
No. Everything is processed in your browser, and the page makes no network requests with your input.
